snippet.title: The Witch's Bakery - Official Console Announcement Trailer
snippet.description: Take a look at the Console Announcement Trailer for The Witch's Bakery, a 2D action-adventure game developed by Sunny Lab. Players will embody a witch-baker in the middle of Paris to manage a bakery designed to cater to the public's sweet desires. The Witch's Bakery is launching in 2026 for PlayStation 5 (PS5), Xbox Series X|S, and PC (Steam).
